title: Verify: AdminApp lifecycle stepper unit tests with mocked fetch
summary: Tests AdminApp stepper stage for OPEN, RUNNING execution, 404 and 401 with a stubbed fetch
description: Component tests written from R2's acceptance criteria; fetch is a vi.fn stub, no network.

steps.action: Create the file with `// @vitest-environment jsdom`, modelled on tests/admin.test.tsx (json helper, enterToken helper, vi.stubGlobal('fetch')). Import roundFixture, adminContributionFixture, executionFixture from './fixtures/api' (round shape mirrors world.Round JSON; execution shape mirrors execution.Execution in backend/internal/execution/execution.go). Stub routes: current round URL → roundFixture; with Bearer secret: admin round URL → round under test, contributions URL → [adminContributionFixture], '/api/v1/admin/executions' → configurable response. Tests: (1) round OPEN, executions [] → within list 'Round lifecycle' the single [aria-current=step] text is 'OPEN'; (2) round {…roundFixture,status:'CLOSED'}, executions [executionFixture with status RUNNING] → current step 'DEVELOPING'; (3) executions responds 404, round OPEN → current step 'OPEN' and screen.queryByRole('alert') is null; (4) executions responds 401 → findByRole('alert') has text 'Invalid token'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminStepper.test.tsx
steps.expected: All four tests pass without network.
